packageRules.description: Review the ogcapi-html frontend dependencies together in one PR. The xtramaps rule below overrides this for @xtramaps packages, so it must stay after this one.
One xtramaps release touches several @xtramaps packages; update them in one PR so they stay on the same release.
The docs dependencies only build the documentation site, so review them together in one PR instead of one per package.
VuePress plugins only work with the vuepress core version they were built against, and the docs are pinned to vuepress 2.0.0-rc.0. Hold all of them until the docs are migrated together.
